items.headline: RBI likely to maintain cautious monetary policy stance amid inflation risks and weakening rupee
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is expected to maintain a cautious stance due to persistent inflation, exacerbated by higher global crude oil prices. September PMIs indicate robust economic growth but also elevated input and output prices. The weakening rupee (around 96.083 against the US dollar) increases import costs.

items.headline: US-Iran conflict escalates, driving Brent crude near $100; FIIs net sellers in Indian equities
items.summary:
The ongoing US-Iran conflict and President Trump's rejection of Iran's proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz renew concerns about prolonged oil supply disruptions. Brent crude prices have surged near or above $100 per barrel. Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) have been net sellers, selling approximately 
17,131 crore in September.

items.headline: Q4 FY26 earnings season shows strong growth; key companies announce results
items.summary: The Q4 FY26 earnings season saw 74% of tracked companies reporting, with average revenue growth of 38.6% year-on-year and profit growth of 66.3% year-on-year. Indian Oil Corporation, Larsen & Toubro, Maruti Suzuki India, JSW Steel, HDFC Life Insurance, Kotak Mahindra Bank, ITC, Jindal Steel, New India Assurance Company, and LTM Limited reported results on September 25, 2026. Several smaller companies are scheduled to announce results today.

items.headline: IT sector surges 3.71%, leads market gains; Healthcare sector declines
items.summary: The IT sector was a standout performer, surging 3.71% and leading overall market gains. Conversely, the BSE Healthcare sector declined by 0.51%, emerging as the top laggard due to profit-taking and cautious sentiment.

items.headline: Adani Power completes merger of 10 subsidiaries
items.summary: Adani Power completed the merger of 10 wholly-owned subsidiaries with the company, effective September 25, 2026.

items.headline: SAIL and BCCL sign MoU for joint coal block development
items.summary: State-owned Steel Authority of India Ltd (SAIL) and Bharat Coking Coal Ltd (BCCL) have signed an MoU to jointly develop and operate two coal blocks in West Bengal.

items.headline:
Power Grid to raise 
10,000 crore loan from SBI; wins Maharashtra transmission project
items.summary:
Power Grid's board approved raising up to 
10,000 crore through an unsecured rupee term loan/line of credit from State Bank of India. The company was also declared the successful bidder for a Maharashtra transmission project.

items.headline: RPG Life Sciences to amalgamate subsidiary Actis Generics for simplification
items.summary: RPG Life Sciences approved the amalgamation of its wholly-owned subsidiary, Actis Generics, to simplify its structure and reduce costs.

items.headline: Signatureglobal acquires 194.22 acres in Gurugram for ultra-luxury villas
items.summary:
Signatureglobal acquired approximately 194.22 acres of land in Farrukhnagar, Gurugram, for ultra-luxury villas, adding an estimated 
5,500-6,000 crore in gross development value to its pipeline.

items.headline:
AGI Infra board approves 
275 crore QIP fundraise
items.summary:
AGI Infra's board approved raising up to 
275 crore through a Qualified Institutional Placement (QIP).

items.headline: Cupid board approves conversion of warrants to equity shares in Baazar Style Retail
items.summary: Cupid's board approved the conversion of up to 30 lakh warrants into an equivalent number of equity shares of Baazar Style Retail Ltd.

items.headline: KPI Green Energy subsidiary completes DMGEL stake acquisition
items.summary: KPI Green Energy's subsidiary, SDEL, completed the acquisition of a 62.91% stake in DMGEL.

items.headline: Aastha Spintex Ltd announces bonus issue
items.summary: Aastha Spintex Ltd has a bonus issue with an ex-date and record date of September 28, 2026.

items.headline: Jattashankar Industries Ltd and Meenakshi India Ltd announce stock splits
items.summary: Jattashankar Industries Ltd and Meenakshi India Ltd have stock splits scheduled for today, September 28, 2026.

items.headline: E2E Networks Ltd and Kerala Ayurveda Ltd announce fundraising plans
items.summary: E2E Networks Ltd and Kerala Ayurveda Ltd have fundraising plans approved by their respective boards.

items.headline: Corporate Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026 proposes changes to M&A transactions
items.summary: The Corporate Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026, proposes significant changes to M&A transaction planning and execution in India, including expanding eligibility for fast-track mergers and modifying buyback conditions.

items.headline: Godrej Properties to launch new luxury housing project in Marine Lines
items.summary: Godrej Properties is in focus for a new luxury housing project in Marine Lines.

items.summary: NMDC is in focus for eyeing a new pellet plant.

items.headline: Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers in focus for ammonia plant revamp order
items.summary: Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers is in focus for an ammonia plant revamp order.

items.headline: Tata Power receives Ministry of Power letter for Mundra Thermal Plant extension
items.summary: Tata Power received a letter from the Ministry of Power regarding the extension of validity for directions issued under Section 11 of the Electricity Act for its Mundra Thermal Plant.

items.headline: APSEZ's Dhamra Port transitions to 100% renewable power
items.summary: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone (APSEZ)'s Dhamra Port in Odisha has transitioned to 100% renewable power.

items.headline: USFDA completes inspection of Zydus Lifesciences' pharmacovigilance system with nil observations
items.summary: The USFDA completed an on-site inspection of Zydus Lifesciences' pharmacovigilance system with nil observations.

items.headline: USFDA inspection at Unichem Labs Goa facility concludes with five observations
items.summary: A USFDA inspection at Unichem Laboratories' Goa facility concluded with five observations.

items.headline: Prestige Hospitality Ventures withdraws DRHP
items.summary: Prestige Estates Projects' subsidiary, Prestige Hospitality Ventures, withdrew its draft red herring prospectus (DRHP) due to strategic considerations and uncertain market conditions.

items.headline: NTPC Green Energy commences commercial operations of Kalasar Solar Project capacity
items.summary: NTPC Green Energy commenced commercial operations of the first 81.34 MW capacity of the 650 MW Kalasar Solar Energy Project.

items.headline: Indian Energy Exchange subsidiary applies for coal exchange registration
items.summary: Indian Energy Exchange (IEE)'s subsidiary applied to the Coal Controller Organisation for coal exchange registration.

items.summary: Augmont Enterprises was empanelled by NSE as a key partner for Electronic Gold Receipts (EGR).
